role: pre-release real-data reference; excluded from generated-method rankings

requirements: chunk manifest SHA-256 matches the frozen value
manifest declares exactly 3544 unique model roots, 531937 files, and 86992752890 input bytes
manifest declares exactly 84 categories, 10 sources, and 2 chunks
every declared model root exists and no extra category/source/model root is present
the extracted data tree contains exactly 531937 regular non-symlink files totaling 86992752890 bytes
each frozen chunk exists and matches its declared SHA-256 for a paper-final run
readiness_gate.on_failure: write readiness evidence only; do not freeze a cohort or report Table 6 scores

denominators.release_asset: one unique model root in the frozen chunk manifest
denominators.annotation_record: one raw object in articulations.json::articulations, including fixed/free marker records
denominators.semantic_joint: one unique pid with at least one supported motion-bearing annotation after composite grouping
denominators.semantic_dof: scalar degrees of freedom implied by a semantic joint after the frozen type policy
denominators.exported_scalar_dof: one scalar executable coordinate in the URDF export
denominators.motion_intent_asset: one asset identity frozen into the N=100 cohort before any load, contact, or FCL outcome
denominators.motion_evaluable_asset: one frozen motion-intent asset whose native collision package and all required joint trajectories are supported by the evaluator
denominators.collision_state: one recorded native-package configuration; absence of collision geometry never counts as collision-free

free.reason: the released official renderer maps free to fixed and released free records can lack axes and ranges; this protocol does not invent six executable DoFs

multi_dof.reason: the release renderer defines no deterministic scalar-coordinate schema for this label; keep it in the raw-record/type inventory and do not invent a DoF count

screw.coupling: rotation and translation are one coupled coordinate

cylindrical.mapping: one annotation pid may map to two proxy URDF joints; count one semantic joint, two semantic DoFs, and two exported movable joint elements

universal.mapping: explicit universal records, or exactly two revolute records sharing one pid, map to two ordered scalar coordinates; missing second-axis/origin/range metadata is not repaired

composite_grouping.derived_cylindrical: the same pid containing both revolute and prismatic records and no explicit higher-precedence composite
composite_grouping.free_with_supported_motion: ignore the free marker for DoF counting but retain it in raw annotation-record diagnostics

annotation_to_urdf_audit.purpose: release self-consistency and export fidelity diagnostics only
mapping_keys: fallback joint name joint_{pid}_to_* recorded as heuristic
annotation_to_urdf_audit.coordinate_note: annotation axes/origins are Y-up; the released renderer applies a +90 degree X rotation for Z-up use
annotation_to_urdf_audit.origin_comparison: do not compare raw origins by a single global rotation when URDF origins are parent-link-relative; a full frame reconstruction is required
reported_diagnostics: semantic joint to exported element mapping coverage
axis metadata presence and finite nonzero rate
origin metadata presence and finite rate
declared range presence and finite ordered rate
forbidden_claims: joint type accuracy against the source annotation
joint recall against the source annotation
semantic parent-child accuracy against the source annotation
axis, origin, or limit accuracy without independent gold

metrics: annotation JSON parseability and type distribution
annotation records, semantic joints, and semantic DoFs
URDF XML parseability, connected acyclic tree, and movable exported DoFs
all referenced collision mesh paths resolve to nonempty files
positive finite mass and inertia-diagonal coverage
static_motion_eligibility: at least one exported scalar DoF
all visual-bearing links have native collision geometry
all collision mesh references resolve to nonempty native files
semantic-joint to exported-element mapping is complete

motion_cohort.candidate_pool: assets passing the frozen static motion-eligibility gate
motion_cohort.category_policy: first allocate one asset to every eligible category, up to 84 categories
motion_cohort.source_policy: Hamilton source quotas proportional to the eligible pool; category selections and extra selections prefer the largest remaining source quota
motion_cohort.extra_slots: after category coverage, fill to 100 by largest remaining source quota, then lowest selected count in the candidate category, then tie-break hash
motion_cohort.unsupported_composite_policy: retain the frozen asset; unsupported screw/universal/free execution is not_evaluable and never replaced

adapter.input: content-hashed motion_cohort_manifest.json plus its bound static/readiness/protocol artifacts
adapter.semantic_coordinate_policy: sample semantic DoFs and map them to exported coordinates; aggregate joint pass by pid
adapter.composite_proxy_policy: collapse no-geometry joint chains sharing artiverse_pid before semantic parent-child collision exclusion
adapter.screw_execution: execution-only prismatic plus revolute proxy driven by frozen pitch coupling; inconsistent or incomplete coupling is not_evaluable

discrete_proxy.pair_filter: exclude contacts within the same fixed-link cluster and contacts across semantic parent-child adjacency after transparent artiverse_pid composite-proxy collapse
discrete_proxy.contact_distance_semantics: PyBullet contact tuple field 8; negative is penetration and positive is distance
discrete_proxy.within_tolerance_contact_policy: retained contact manifolds with contactDistance >= -1e-6 m are reported separately and do not fail the penetration-free proxy
discrete_proxy.witness_policy: each penetration-failing asset stores first and deepest witnesses with trajectory, state index, semantic configuration hash, link pair, signed contactDistance, and penetration depth; each scalar coordinate and semantic pid stores its single-sweep result
discrete_proxy.label: discrete penetration-free proxy on frozen paths

strict_continuous.collision_engine: python-fcl 0.7 exact BVH collide and signed distance
strict_continuous.certificate: clearance-Lipschitz rigid-motion bound with adaptive bisection

table6_reporting.articulable: load-and-drive rate on the frozen N=100 cohort with pass/fail/not_evaluable counts
table6_reporting.joints_per_asset: report semantic joints/asset, semantic DoFs/asset, and exported movable elements/asset separately
table6_reporting.native_joint_exposure: direct package and mapping coverage, not semantic correctness
table6_reporting.joint_type_accuracy: N/A for a reference evaluated against its own annotations
table6_reporting.joint_recall: N/A for a reference evaluated against its own annotations
table6_reporting.axis_valid: metadata-valid and export-consistency diagnostics only; semantic accuracy N/A
table6_reporting.origin_valid: metadata-valid diagnostics only; semantic accuracy N/A
table6_reporting.limit_valid: metadata-valid diagnostics only; semantic accuracy N/A
table6_reporting.joint_geom_valid: strict continuous collision certificate on supported native trajectories; axis-on-moving-part semantic correctness remains N/A
table6_reporting.asset_geom_valid: all supported joints certified and no unsupported trajectory; otherwise fail or not_evaluable as declared
table6_reporting.full_range_collision_free: strict certificate result; N/E until strict is executed, and never filled from the PyBullet penetration-free proxy
table6_reporting.generic_range: revolute annotations with declared span at least 300 degrees, plus continuous joints reported separately

resource_plan.full_static_estimate: 5-20 minutes on local SSD, dominated by 531937-file traversal and XML/JSON parsing
resource_plan.n100_discrete_estimate: 10-60 minutes with 4 CPU workers, subject to mesh load tails
resource_plan.n100_strict_estimate: 1-8 wall-clock hours with 4 CPU workers and 3600-second per-asset timeout
resource_plan.full_3544_strict: not recommended before the frozen N=100 run; observed exact-FCL runtime has a heavy tail
